offering_description.value: The company underwrites tailored primary and excess casualty, professional liability, and healthcare liability insurance for organizations. It offers policies through American Family Insurance affiliates and assumes risks from American Family Insurance through its reinsurer.

quotes.quote: Bowhead Specialty provides tailored primary and excess insurance coverage solutions across multiple core divisions: Professional Liability, Healthcare Liability, and Casualty. Visit our appetite page for details of coverages offered.

Bowhead Specialty Underwriters, Inc., a licensed agency nationwide, is an affiliate of American Family Insurance. Bowhead Specialty offers products through American Family Insurance affiliates on an admitted and surplus lines basis. Bowhead Insurance Company Inc. is a fully capitalized reinsurer that assumes risks from American Family Insurance.

primary_products.value: Casualty insurance; directors and officers and management liability insurance; cyber insurance; errors and omissions insurance; healthcare liability insurance including medical malpractice

quotes.quote: Tailored underwriting for standard and complex risks. We offer Directors & Officers, Management Liability, Cyber, and Errors & Omissions coverage on admitted and non-admitted paper, serving public, private, and not-for-profit organizations, including financial institutions.

Yes. We offer both primary and excess coverage across multiple lines, including General Liability, Professional Liability, and Healthcare Liability, giving clients the flexibility to build layered programs that align with their risk management strategies.

We don’t believe in one-size-fits-all policies. Our underwriting-first model is backed by deep sector expertise, advanced analytics, and technology. Our core craft solutions are custom-built to meet the specific needs, risk profiles, and goals of our clients.
